title: Choose the Match visual world
question: The roll assigned Pinball Playfield. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Pinball Playfield
options.lineage: Electromechanical arcade cabinets and glass playfields
options.thesis: Match is the glass playfield; the future run shell is the cabinet around it.
options.viewport: Desktop: cabinet rails as run chrome; dual-seat lanes under glass; Draft as lit target banks; fight fires as bumper flashes with twin Life reels.
options.risk: Kinetic chrome can bury Boon names unless offers stay large labeled target banks.

options.label: Celestial Star Atlas
options.lineage: Night-sky magnitude charts with faint mythic figures
options.thesis: Gods are constellations on a navy plate; Draft picks stars; the fight pulses magnitudes.
options.viewport: Contained chart plate in the run shell; dual hemispheres for seats; offer row as catalog stars; Life as magnitude ramps.
options.risk: Spectacle stays quiet unless magnitude pulses carry fight energy.
options.case: Wins Greek-god audience ID; quieter kinetic fight than a playfield.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.lineage: Early one-bit windowed desktops with marching-ants selection
options.thesis: Draft is overlapping windows; the fight is the desktop coming alive under marching ants.
options.viewport: Run shell as desktop menu bar; Match as a titled window; offers as dialogs; Loadout icons; active Boon wears marching ants.
options.risk: Reads as tool nostalgia before auto-battler, so spectacle must be earned in motion.
options.case: Wins Draft Operate clarity; loses auto-battler spectacle identification.

options.label: Miura Orbit Sheet
options.lineage: Deployable Miura-fold packets that open into rigid crease fields
options.thesis: Match deploys from a hand-sized run packet into a locked crease stage, then folds away.
options.viewport: Packet in the run shell expands to a parallelogram Match field; Draft cells along creases; fight locks the sheet rigid.
options.risk: Crease topology can feel more origami demo than contested fight.
options.case: Wins containment-in-run story; fuses poorly when Boon fires need kinetic punch.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark auto-battler HUD with shop-row Draft and twin HP bars, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar TFT/Auto Chess chrome: offer row, loadout tray, centered fight readouts inside a run frame.
canonCard.risk: Readable and expected; erases this product’s god-draft mechanism as a look.
